subtitle: Two bases, one fast train, and a snow day bolted on — because the brief asked for snow and Spain does not have any.
footer: Madrid and Barcelona · 5–12 Dec 2026 · built 2 Oct 2026

critical.headline: You asked for cold and snow. Spain in December has neither.
critical.detail: Madrid runs 1–5 °C overnight and 10–13 °C by day; Barcelona 8.5–13.4 °C. Neither city gets snow. Monday is a deliberate snow day in the Sierra de Guadarrama to answer that — and it is the one thing on this page that may not happen, because the season only opens in early December.

sections.title: The route
sections.note_html: Fly into Madrid, out of Barcelona, so no leg is retraced. The AVE does the middle in 2 h 30.

sections.title: Weather, day by day
sections.note_html: Every row is the long-term average for that place on that date. The mountain is a different climate from the cities.

sections.title: Flights
sections.note_html: Iberia is the only nonstop from San Francisco to Madrid, and it runs Tuesdays, Thursdays and Saturdays. 5 December is a Saturday.

sections.title: Where you sleep
sections.note_html: Both picked for a single room or apartment that sleeps four.

sections.title: Before you leave
sections.note_html: Passports and flights decide the trip. The snow day cannot be booked until the season opens.

sections.title: The week
sections.tag: one or two anchors a day
sections.note_html: Spain eats late and starts late, and sunset is at 17:49 — nearly two hours later than central Europe. Mornings are slower here on purpose.

sections.title: The places
sections.note_html: Children under 18 are free at the Prado. Everything marked with a dot still needs checking on the operator's own site.

sections.title: Budget
sections.note_html: Unlike a central-European December, this one fits — at the low end. Spain is the cheaper half of the comparison.

weather_notice.detail_html: A reliable one appears about ten days out — from roughly 25 November. These are long-term averages for each place on each date. The mountain row is derived from altitude, not a published average, and is the one to check hardest.

weather.note_html: SFO late afternoon, overnight to Madrid.
Land early afternoon. Dry and bright, far milder than you asked for.
Roughly 12 °C colder than Madrid. Whether there is snow at all depends on the season opening — check Valdesquí before you go.
Museums are indoors; the market runs to 21:00.
On the AVE through the middle of it. Barcelona is noticeably milder.
Park Güell closes at 17:30 from November, so it is a morning or early-afternoon job.
Only about 5–6 rainy days in a Barcelona December, so odds are good.

fare_note.detail_html: Headline deal fares advertised for this route sit near $330 return, but those are off-peak singles and rarely survive four seats in December. Budget on the range below, not the headline.

places.note: 22 km of runs, 12 of them green, with a ski school and a beginners' snow area. The season opens in early December — this is the one booking that may simply not exist.
Smaller, about 10 km of trails, and reviewers call it the friendlier of the two for children who have never skied.
Children and teenagers are free at any time, though they still need a timed ticket. Entry is free for everyone from 18:00.
The largest functioning royal palace in Europe by floor area. Hours shift around state occasions, so check the week before.
104 stalls, running to 31 December. Heavy on nativity figures, toys and joke items rather than food.

Published prices disagree badly between resellers and the basilica's own site, so none is quoted here. Book direct and check what a ten-year-old costs — the under-10 concession will not apply to twins who have just turned ten.
The winter closing time is the thing to plan around: 17:30, not 19:30. Arrive by 15:00 or it is not worth the fare.
In front of the cathedral in the Gothic Quarter. Smaller and older than Madrid's, and the caga tió stalls will need explaining to the boys.

steps.html: Late November — has the Guadarrama season opened? The resorts publish it.
Monday is the snow day. Book the ski school in advance; December weekends fill.
Monday becomes the Prado and the Royal Palace, and Tuesday becomes a free day in Madrid.
Nothing else on the page moves. The snow day is deliberately isolated so losing it costs one day, not the trip.
